## It’s not the benchmark that matters

Grok 4.6 launched this week at frontier-level performance, matching GPT-5.6 Sol on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Every headline will lead with that number. Every headline will miss the point.

The real question isn’t whether Grok 4.6 is the smartest coding model. It’s what happens when a sufficiently capable, dramatically cheaper model gets privileged access to one of the world’s most important AI coding interfaces.

Grok 4.6 didn’t arrive alone. It’s the visible tip of a position Musk has spent months assembling piece by piece.

- Grok 4.6 provides the model.

- Cursor provides developer distribution.

- Grok Build provides the terminal agent.

- SpaceXAI provides the infrastructure and capital.

Musk isn’t competing for a slot in the model selector anymore. He’s trying to own the stack around it.
